title: On-prem milestone lattice and OKR traceability for isolated deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: produce a quarter-level milestone lattice that maps feature deliverables, engineering slices, and verification activities to explicit OKRs for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise customers. Scope: roadmap sequencing for tenant isolation, upgrade/runbook improvements, RBAC & audit integrations, compatibility test matrix for customer OS/hypervisor variants, and activation cohort plans. Deliverables: 1) Milestone lattice (weekly cadence) with owners and acceptance gates, 2) OKR trace doc linking each milestone to measurable signals, 3) Runbook and compatibility checklist for first 3 customer cohorts, 4) Release gating criteria for canary -> tranche -> GA. Success metrics (mapped to OKRs): - Time-to-activate for a tranche (goal: <= 10 business days) - Post-upgrade P0 incidents per tranche (goal: 0, threshold <1 per 100 activations) - Onboarding throughput (goal: 5 tranches / quarter) - Compatibility cert pass rate across top-5 customer infra profiles (goal: >=95%) Acceptance criteria: each milestone includes a test plan, required telemetry dashboard, rollforward plan, and documented rollback criteria. Risks & mitigations: 1) Hardware variance across customers -> maintain minimal supported matrix and early compatibility lab; 2) Migration complexity for tenants with heavy KV/cache usage -> add preflight resource scans and simulated load tests; 3) Cross-team bandwidth for Dedicated infra -> lock down engineering slices and hire temporary SRE support for rollout windows. Stakeholders: PM (owner), Eng runtime, Infra SRE, Design (console gating), Security & Compliance. Next steps: align owners on milestone lattice, schedule 2-weekly check-ins, finalize canary cohort selection by 2025-01-24, surface capacity needs to infra by 2025-01-30.
